context.purpose: Check one finished EPUB publication with the official W3C EPUBCheck before hand-over, publishing its JSON assessment and a summary only when the checker reports no fatal, error or warning messages and a fresh check of the held bytes agrees. Unsuitable for repairing, converting or rendering books, accessibility or legal certification, DRM or expanded EPUB folders.
context.assumptions: A captured local EPUB ZIP (at most 32 MiB, 2000 members, 64 MiB uncompressed) and a configured trusted EPUBCheck 5.4 launcher that starts the official JAR with its lib directory and Java. The host reads no EPUB content semantically; it preflights the container and checks the native report for consistency.
context.constraints: Default profile, English messages and --failonwarnings only; no authored flags, Java, profiles, plugins or message severities. No encrypted members, symlinks, unsafe or duplicate names, entity declarations, non-catalogue DOCTYPE SYSTEM identifiers or unsupported XML encodings (UTF-8 and byte-order-marked UTF-16 only), whatever the file name of an XML member the package declares, and no non-ASCII names without the ZIP UTF-8 flag. Exactly EPUBCheck 5.4.0. The checker runs with its fixed offline property (not an operating-system network boundary). Zero findings is a scoped tool result, not rendering, accessibility or legal certification.
context.inspection: Inspect assessment.json (the native report) and epubcheck-summary.json (source hash and member counts, checker counts, publication facts, per-file rows). verify needs the trusted launcher (SCHEMAXIS_EPUBCHECK or a stored epubcheck location; --epubcheck belongs to run): it re-checks the held captured bytes and compares every stable assessment field.
context.recovery: INVALID_EPUB_SOURCE: absolute regular local .epub. INVALID_EPUB_ARCHIVE: not a readable ZIP. UNSAFE_EPUB_ARCHIVE: unsafe, duplicate or link members. UNSUPPORTED_EPUB_FEATURE: encrypted members, entities, non-catalogue DTDs or unsupported XML encodings. EPUB_BUDGET: reduce below the byte, member or expansion limits. EPUBCHECK_REJECTED: fix the findings in rejected-assessment.json and rerun; nothing was published. EPUBCHECK_REPORT_INVALID: the native report was unusable. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure the launcher. UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME: use EPUBCheck 5.4.0 through a launcher that starts Java directly so the fixed offline JVM notice appears. NATIVE_UNAVAILABLE/NATIVE_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: repair the launcher or Java, or reduce the publication (a report larger than the 8 MiB budget is resource exhaustion; heap size is the trusted launcher's own setting). VERIFICATION_FAILED: the captured bytes, assessment, evidence or its JSON types changed; rerun into a fresh directory.

workflow.scope: A verified file artifact (such as the EPUB published by a Pandoc report, artifact index 3) can be the source; the assessment and summary publish through the normal scheduler with provenance.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure expressions and finite studies resolve before the native recipe.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers the version probe, the check and the fresh verification check. Each child: CPU limit 380 s on two CPUs, output size capped at 8 MiB for the report, JVM heap fixed by the trusted launcher; standalone verify has a 300 s budget.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned process-group cancellation; serial children and a final cancellation/deadline check before publication, so no native worker outlives the run.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/effective plan, captured EPUB and byte binding, exact launchers, input hashes, stage stdout/stderr/submissions, the native assessment (rejected-assessment.json on rejection) and an independently recomputed summary.
lifecycle.verification: Container preflight plus a fresh trusted EPUBCheck run on a private copy of the held captured bytes, compared field by field with the retained assessment (checkDate and elapsedTime excluded), the report items against the container files and the recomputed summary. EPUBCheck is the oracle; the host adds no semantic EPUB validator.

losses: Nothing is changed; encrypted, link, entity, non-catalogue-DTD and unsupported-encoding members are refused.

traits.policy: zero fatal, error and warning messages

losses: Published only for an accepted publication; a rejected run keeps its findings as evidence only.

inspection.scope: JSON assessment and summary: counts, publication facts, per-file rows and the assessment hash.
inspection.limits: Host summary recomputed during verification; no rendering and no reading-system test.

authoring.reuse: Change the absolute source. Retain source bytes for provenance; same-path byte changes invalidate scheduler reuse.

workflow.scope: A verified file artifact (such as the EPUB of a Pandoc report) can be the source through the normal scheduler.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure expressions and finite studies resolve before the native recipe.

reusable-inputs.scope: The absolute source path and captured byte digest participate in reuse identity.

source-authoring.scope: Editable JSON source with common undo and validation.

property-authoring.scope: Common pointer forms expose the source field; the contract has no other authored properties.

conversion.scope: EPUBCheck is a checker; it converts nothing.

native-inspection.scope: No interactive native inspection; the audio file and its JSON summary are ordinary publications.

mpi.scope: The recipe is serial; each native process is a single thread.

time-batches.scope: No temporal batching; common finite studies remain available.

live-editing.scope: No persistent native session; edit JSON then create a new bounded run.

native-save.scope: FLAC and WAV publications are supported; there is no application session or project save.

cases.scope: Hand-built minimal EPUB 3: mimetype, container, package, navigation and one chapter (5 files, 1283 bytes uncompressed, one spine item, title Tiny). Counts come from the fixture design, independent of the adaptor. The decision is a fresh native EPUBCheck run on the held bytes.

Hand-built EPUB 3 with two spine chapters, a stylesheet and a one-pixel PNG (8 files, two spine items, every resource referenced). Counts are literal from the fixture design; fresh native EPUBCheck run on the held bytes is the decision.

completion.scope: New adaptor 2026-10-25 (allocation 52): schemaxis.epubcheck/1 validate route, container preflight, closed typed native report parser, fixed EPUBCheck 5.4 launcher stages, fresh trusted native recheck of the held bytes, discovery, guidance, Studio starter and bounded native acceptance against the official 5.4.0 distribution through a private fixed launcher.

notApplicable.native-inspection: No interactive native inspection; the assessment and its JSON summary are ordinary publications.
notApplicable.mpi: The checker is serial and limited to two CPUs.
notApplicable.time-batches: No temporal batching; common finite studies remain available.
notApplicable.live-editing: No persistent native session; edit JSON then create a new bounded run.
notApplicable.native-save: There is no application session or project save; the checker only reads the EPUB.
